content: Northgate owes us 185,550 across 16 invoices past due. draft a firm but friendly email to their owner

Subject: Past-due balance — Meridian

Hi Rob,
Thanks for the continued business. We have $185,550 past due across 16 invoices, oldest due 2026-08-29. Can you confirm a payment date this week? Per our terms we'll need to move new orders to prepay if we can't agree a plan by Friday.

Kenji
AI tools spend by month: Jul 4.4k Aug 4.8k Sep 5.2k. extrapolate to Dec and write one line for Sam
At ~8%/month, AI tools reach ~$6.5k/month by December (~$70k annualised).
